question.text: A beam of light consisting of red, green and blue colours is incident on a right-angled prism on face $A B$. The refractive indices of the material for the above red, green and blue colours are $1.39,1.44$ and $1.47$ respectively. A person looking on surface $A C$ of the prism will see

solution.text:
For light to come out through face 'AC', total internal reflection must not take place.
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \text { i.e., } \theta < c \Rightarrow \sin \theta < \sin c \\
& \Rightarrow \sin \theta < \frac{1}{\mu}
\end{aligned}
$$
or $\quad \mu < \frac{1}{\sin \theta} \Rightarrow \mu < \frac{1}{\sin 45^{\circ}}$
$$
\Rightarrow \mu < \sqrt{2} \Rightarrow \mu < 1.414
$$
